title: Serbia’s Student List has been inspirational, but the big test will be forming a stable anti-corruption government
lede: The Serbian campaign looked exceptional. I cannot think of many cases of an opposition that was so decentralised and so democratic internally. The closest comparison may be the early German Greens that had a strong Basisdemokratie ["Grassroots Democracy"] out of conviction; or the faceless and fluid democratic movement in Hong Kong ("Be Water") out of necessity. This is inspirational.

title: Comment: Investors’ plausible deniability on forced labour is over
lede: Investors must take meaningful steps to prevent forced labour in global supply chains, writes Transparentem's Sheela Ahluwalia.
